verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a workflow automation product, but nothing in the evidence documents adding an AI agent or LLM step inside a Zap workflow, and nothing mentions model choice. Zapier Agents (zapier-docs-8) is a standalone agent feature, not a step within a workflow. MCP lets external AI clients call Zapier actions, which is the reverse direction. AI-generated troubleshooting is an adjacent feature. None of these counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use
